identity.condition: An out-of-range entry separates composable codepoints.
identity.capability: Preserve the entry and prevent composition across it.

requirement: With COMPOSE enabled, preserve an out-of-range UTF-32 entry and prevent composition across it.

assessment.necessity_reason: The harness copies fuzzer bytes into a UTF-32 buffer and calls normalization, so a finite input can contain composable codepoints separated by 0x110000. Each direct call omits COMPOSE. The UTF-8 mapping calls cannot provide that out-of-range entry as an equivalent route.

before.requirement: When normalizing UTF-32 with COMPOSE, preserve an out-of-range entry and prevent composition across it.
before.reason: The source passes the entry through and resets composition state, but the old harness never enables COMPOSE for its direct UTF-32 calls. UTF-8 decoding cannot supply 0x110000.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The UTF-8 decoder rejects encodings outside the Unicode codepoint range.
The UTF-8 mapping decomposition route rejects an out-of-range codepoint.

after.requirement: When normalizing UTF-32 with COMPOSE, preserve an out-of-range entry and prevent composition across it.
after.reason: The composition guard remains, while the same old harness still omits COMPOSE from every direct UTF-32 call. UTF-8 mapping remains unable to carry the out-of-range entry.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The UTF-8 decoder rejects encodings outside the Unicode codepoint range.
The UTF-8 mapping decomposition route still rejects an out-of-range codepoint.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: These alternate normalization and mapping calls take the input as UTF-8 rather than preserving an out-of-range UTF-32 entry.

assessment.comparison_reason: The same COMPOSE-gated UTF-32 behavior exists on both sides, and the same fixed option choices prevent the old harness from reaching it on both sides.

necessity_evidence.reason: The same UTF-32 COMPOSE behavior is supported before and after g0002, but the fixed harness never enables COMPOSE in its direct UTF-32 calls. This is a preexisting coverage gap.
necessity_evidence.finite_witness: Supply native-endian UTF-32 words [0x1100, 0x110000, 0x1161, 0x0000] as 16 bytes. The final byte is NUL, and the harness copies all four words. With COMPOSE, the out-of-range middle word must remain and prevent the Hangul pair from composing across it; none of the harness's direct calls enables that option.

scope_contract.reason: The entry directly normalizes fuzzer-controlled UTF-32 words. The source exposes COMPOSE for that operation and handles out-of-range words in its composition pass.

evidence.dependency_reason: The harness copies input bytes into the UTF-32 buffer and invokes the operation.

feasible_trigger.reason: A 16-byte, NUL-ending input passes the entry guards and supplies the four stated UTF-32 words. The source's Hangul composition case shows that 0x1100 and 0x1161 are composable when adjacent; 0x110000 triggers the intervening out-of-range guard.

evidence.dependency_reason: The finite input meets the entry's size and final-NUL requirements.
The entry copies the supplied words into its normalization buffer.

observable_consequence.reason: With COMPOSE, the source passes the out-of-range word through and clears composition state, preventing composition across it. The harness's fixed direct-call options make this specific supported behavior unreachable.

evidence.dependency_reason: Every direct UTF-32 call omits COMPOSE.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: All direct UTF-32 calls omit COMPOSE. The NFC and UTF-8 mapping routes can use COMPOSE, but their UTF-8 decoder cannot supply 0x110000, and decomposition rejects an out-of-range codepoint. They therefore cannot exercise the same tuple.

evidence.dependency_reason: The complete call sequence shows the direct options and the alternate UTF-8 routes.
Decomposition rejects 0x110000 if it is supplied by a route other than UTF-8 decoding.

identity_preserved.reason: Both versions support the same tuple: COMPOSE normalization of UTF-32 with an out-of-range separator. The old harness has the same missing option on both sides, so the blocker is preexisting.

evidence.dependency_reason: The fixed harness uses identical direct UTF-32 calls for both assessments.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The alternate UTF-8 route cannot decode the out-of-range separator.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: With COMPOSE, utf8proc_normalize_utf32 preserves an out-of-range UTF-32 word and resets composition state so surrounding composable words remain separate.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The harness copies fuzzer bytes into UTF-32 words, then calls utf8proc_normalize_utf32 six times with fixed options that all omit UTF8PROC_COMPOSE.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: Composition handling with an out-of-range UTF-32 separator cannot be reached through any direct call.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: NFC and UTF-8 mapping use UTF-8 input; decoding and decomposition cannot carry 0x110000 to the same normalization behavior.
